entries.justification: Dependency-first linked emission groups each CSS module and places imported modules before the entry without changing parsed semantics.
Dependency-first linked emission groups each SCSS module and places imported modules before the entry without changing parsed semantics.
Dependency-first linked emission groups each Less module and places imported modules before the entry without changing parsed semantics.
The linked path emits the shared dependency once, groups modules, and preserves dependency-first order while the legacy path repeats the shared import.
The legacy path applies the entry rewrite table across imported declarations while linked emission retains module-local rewrite ordinals and import-graph order.
The linked path restores the dependency-owned selector selected by its own source reference, preserves declarations sharing a live emitted selector token, and removes unrelated dead selectors.
The linked path retains the dependency declaration reached through composes, keeps the dependency-owned live selector, and removes the unrelated dead selector.
The linked path retains the class reached through composes and the live class nested in an at-rule while removing both unrelated dead selectors.
The authored liveness table keeps both hops of the composed class chain while unrelated declarations remain dead.
The linked path retains the declaration reached through a package-shaped module path and removes its unrelated peer.
The linked path preserves directly referenced declarations nested under media, supports, and layer rules while retaining global escapes outside local liveness.
A direct reference keeps every rule carrying the live class while companion names remain outside the per-name liveness set.
A workspace-only stylesheet reference keeps the composed build-module declaration without admitting its unrelated peer.
The authored table records that declarations reachable only through an unreferenced referrer remain dead while the entry declaration stays live.
The element-only dependency is emitted before its importer according to the declared import order; the remaining byte difference is ASCII whitespace.
The bare layer statement is emitted before its importer according to the declared import order; the remaining byte difference is ASCII whitespace.
The comment-only dependency retains an explicit module boundary and is emitted before its importer; the remaining byte difference is ASCII whitespace.
The bounded product corpus follows dependency-first module grouping while retaining the same parsed semantics as legacy import inlining.
